.. py:class:: DiffusionPolicy(cfg: DiffusionPolicyConfig)

   Bases: :py:obj:`torch.nn.Module`


   Diffusion policy combining a PointNet encoder with a conditional UNet.


   .. py:attribute:: cfg


   .. py:attribute:: encoder


   .. py:attribute:: unet


   .. py:attribute:: scheduler


   .. py:attribute:: num_inference_steps


   .. py:attribute:: horizon


   .. py:attribute:: action_dim


   .. py:attribute:: n_obs_steps


   .. py:attribute:: normalizer


   .. py:attribute:: _normalizer_ready
      :value: False



   .. py:method:: encode_observation(point_clouds: torch.Tensor, agent_pos: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor

      Encode stacked observations into a global conditioning vector.

      :param point_clouds: Tensor of shape ``(B, To, N, C)`` with per-frame point clouds.
      :param agent_pos: Tensor of shape ``(B, To, D)`` containing agent states.

      :returns: Encoded tensor with shape ``(B, To * F)`` used to condition the UNet.



   .. py:method:: set_normalizer(normalizer: reworked_diffusion_policy.normalization.LinearNormalizer) -> None

      Attach a frozen normaliser used for both training and sampling.

      :param normalizer: Linear normaliser built from the dataset statistics.



   .. py:method:: compute_loss(batch: Dict[str, torch.Tensor]) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, Dict[str, float]]

      Compute the training objective and scalar metrics for ``batch``.

      :param batch: Mini-batch dictionary with ``point_clouds``, ``agent_pos`` and ``action``.

      :returns: Tuple ``(loss, metrics)`` with the scalar loss tensor and logging dict.



   .. py:method:: sample(point_clouds: torch.Tensor, agent_pos: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor

      Generate denoised action trajectories conditioned on observations.

      :param point_clouds: Tensor with stacked observations ``(B, To, N, C)``.
      :param agent_pos: Tensor with agent states ``(B, To, D)``.

      :returns: Sampled action trajectories with shape ``(B, horizon, action_dim)``.



   .. py:method:: load_state_dict(state_dict, strict: bool = True)

      Restore the module while gracefully handling missing normaliser weights.

      :param state_dict: State dictionary produced by :meth:`state_dict`.
      :param strict: Whether to raise on unexpected or missing keys.

      :returns: ``_IncompatibleKeys`` tuple describing missing/unexpected keys.
